name: Can I be fired for filing a workers' compensation claim?

mainEntity.name: Can I be fired for filing a workers' compensation claim?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, it is illegal for an employer to fire or retaliate against you for filing a legitimate workers' compensation claim in California. State laws protect injured workers from such discrimination. If you believe you have been fired or discriminated against because of your workers' comp claim, a lawyer can help you understand your rights and pursue legal action against your employer for unlawful retaliation, potentially seeking reinstatement, lost wages, and other damages.
